request.state:
ORBITAL LEDGER SOFTWARE — CANCELLATION DESK WORKSHEET
Customer: Vantorre Landscaping BV (account OL-55213). Plan: Ledger Pro, annual, prepaid.

Subscription record
Term 3 (current): 1 September 2027 – 31 August 2028 (both dates inclusive).
Invoice INV-27-09-5521 (1 Sep 2027): Ledger Pro annual, list price EUR 1,722.35; annual-prepay discount 15 % (EUR −258.35); total charged EUR 1,464.00; paid 3 Sep 2027 by SEPA direct debit.
Term 2 (previous): 1 September 2026 – 31 August 2027, invoice INV-26-09-4410, total charged EUR 1,389.00 (then-current price).
Seat add-on: none.

Terms of Service v7.2, section 14 (Cancellation of annual plans)
14.1 An annual plan may be cancelled at any time by written notice. Cancellation takes effect 30 calendar days after the day on which the notice is received by Orbital Ledger; access continues until the end of the effective date.
14.2 Refund. For the days of the term that fall after the effective date, the customer receives a refund of the amount actually charged for the term, pro-rated by calendar days: (amount charged for the term) × (remaining days after the effective date) / (number of days in the term). The result is rounded to the cent.
14.3 Early termination fee. If the effective date falls within the first six months of the term, a fee of EUR 75.00 is deducted from the refund. The first six months of a term beginning on the 1st of a month end on the last day of the sixth month.
14.4 No refund is made for terms that ended before the notice was received, nor for add-ons billed monthly.
14.5 Customers on monthly plans are not refunded; their cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing month.

Correspondence
Received 10 February 2028, 09:12 (support portal, ticket 88410): "Dear Orbital team, we are moving to our parent company's ERP. Please cancel our Ledger Pro subscription. Kind regards, M. Vantorre, managing director." Authority check: Mr Vantorre is listed as account owner — OK.
Sent 10 February 2028: acknowledgement of notice, "the effective date will be confirmed by the cancellation desk".
Received 14 February 2028 (ticket 88410): "Could you tell us the refund amount so we can book it in February?"

Desk notes
- Price check: Ledger Pro list price for new customers was raised to EUR 1,810.00 on 1 January 2028 (does not change existing terms).
- Refund channel: credit to the SEPA mandate account.

decision.instructions: What refund does Vantorre Landscaping receive under section 14 of the Terms of Service?
